title: Locke & Key — Survival, Reproduction, Illusion #Shorts
description:
Once you see Locke & Key as an adaptation, the mystery mostly evaporates. Locke & Key is an American comic book series written by Joe Hill, illustrated by Gabriel Rodríguez, and published by IDW Publishing. In 1775 during the American Revolution, a group of Rebels, hiding in a sea cave in Massachusetts Bay beneath what will one day be Keyhouse in the town of Lovecraft, discover a portal to another dimension, the plains of Leng.

The honest version of Locke & Key starts by giving up the comforting part. The user is then enticed to come into the mirror by their reflection, and upon entering, they find themselves in a dark, empty abyss. Moon Key: Allows the user to reach and open the Moon like a door, which allows the user to pass on to the afterlife peacefully.
